note: Create a Character System 3.14.3: KawaiiPhysics in place of the Bonamik on the four Sephiroth skins (and the forms that wear the same models), from the Rebirth preset (tools/make_kawaii_preset.py): Sephiroth (Rebirth), PC0010_15 (also the OLDER SEPHIROTH form); Sephiroth (Rebirth, Winged), PC0010_10 (also the game's own winged Sephiroth); Remake Sephiroth, EB0021_00 (also the REMAKE form); Remake Sephiroth (Winged), EB0021_01_Body, whose wing (EB0021_01_Wing) follows its bones (also the REMAKE WINGED form). Every physics chain of each model (hair, long hair, coat, belts, collar, the wing's feathers) is a node with the settings tuned on Young Sephiroth; colliders measured from the model (legs, hips, back, neck, head, shoulder pads); the model's Bonamik and KineDriver taken off the model as it loads (both write those bones after KawaiiPhysics). Needs the game mod 3.14.5.
